name: Ijikuri ~Shoujo to Inkou Nikki~
original_name: イジクリ～少女と淫行日記～
source:
Noboru is a school janitor. He really loves girls and installs video cameras everywhere inside school buildings. He says it is for security reasons, but it is wrong. He just gets secrets of female students and sexually assaults them. His current target girls are Akina, Shizuka, and Yuma....
